release: improved (Liu, Engelen et al., IEEE CNS 2022), CSECICIDS2018_improved.zip from https://intrusion-detection.distrinet-research.be/CNS2022/Datasets/
attempted_handling: Labels ending ' - Attempted' (Attempted Category 0-6) are never trained on and are excluded from every primary metric; a secondary metric counts them as benign, pooled without weighting.
inspection_allowed: Before evaluation: file names, sizes, checksums, headers, total row counts, and counts per label and Attempted Category. Schema, unit and label checks run as automated assertions that print only pass or fail. No feature values, scores or rows.
primary_metric: Raw-view recall on each evaluated 2018 family at the threshold set from development validation benign at 1% target FPR, for Config A trained on improved CICIDS2017 with and without the family; realized 2018 FPR reported.
families: Held out in development (>= 200 cleaned rows: bot, brute_force, dos, portscan) and >= 200 cleaned non-Attempted 2018 rows; label mapping in the plan, section 3.
comparisons: Config A seen vs held-out recall per family
B vs A, C vs B, D vs C, E vs D once frozen and added by amendment
shortcut_rule: Applies to primary_treatments only: shortcut-dependent if the mean per-seed raw-recall drop (reference minus treated) at 1% target FPR is >= 0.10 and its 95% bootstrap interval lies above zero; same rule reported in the overlap-excluded and deduplicated views; not testable if reference raw recall < 0.10; all comparisons counted, no correction.
opening: DECIDED 2026-11-09: opened once, at Phase 5, after every configuration, preprocessing, threshold, seed, metric and analysis procedure is frozen and recorded by amendment (plan section 9). Until then: no download, inspection or analysis of the 2018 data, and no use of its results for any decision.

compared_to: reference: same rule, statistics and views; reported in a separate table
no_tcp_window: descriptive paired drop and interval only
no_extractor_features.status: exploratory; defined 2026-11-09 after the development audit; role 'exploratory' in code with primary verdict columns always false; not in n_comparisons or n_shortcut_dependent; changes no verdict in 6.1 or 6.3
no_extractor_features.development_run: after registration, before opening; seeds 0-4; recomputed reference and no_tcp_window rows must equal the recorded ones; reported as post hoc
no_extractor_features.interpretation: a drop is reported as dependence on extractor-specific features, not proof of an artifact

development_findings: Fixed before registration (plan 6.3): bot shortcut-dependent under no_tcp_window, neutralize_missing_markers, all_controls; portscan under no_tcp_window, all_controls; brute_force and dos not dependent. Unresolved: development bot recall depends on portscan in training.

seeds.pairing: every paired comparison (seen vs held-out, reference vs treatment, configuration vs configuration) uses the same seed set on both sides

amendments.amends: plan section 6.2, development run: exact-match reproduction requirement
amendments.reason: The 2026-11-09 development run reproduced every shortcut-rule input exactly, but secondary summaries differed in the last digits (AUC <= 2.2e-16, PR-AUC <= 9.4e-4, one non-primary FPR by 6.3e-6). Suspected thread-order effect in Random Forest probability summation; a hypothesis, not an established cause.

exact: recall in raw, overlap-excluded and deduplicated views at every target FPR
primary FPR: realized FPR at the 1% target FPR in all three evaluation views
every other shortcut-rule input and every other recorded column not listed as tolerated
criterion.order: reproduced treatments run and are checked before any exploratory fold is fitted or any result table written
criterion.report: reproduction.json records, for every tolerated column, the largest absolute difference, its evaluation view, its row (dataset, seed, treatment, family, target FPR) and both values
criterion.on_failure: reported as failed; tolerances are not widened

amendments.scope: numerical reproducibility of secondary summaries only; no change to the evaluation protocol, rule inputs, primary verdicts, frozen Config A or Config A results
amendments.tolerances_set_after_seeing: the reference and no_tcp_window differences listed in the reason; not any exploratory result

amendments.amends: plan section 6.2 (outcome of the development run; section 9.2 condition 4) and the frozen Config A identity

development_run_6_2.failure: auc, one fold (seed 0, no_tcp_window, dos): 3.29e-11 = half of one attack-benign pair; limit 1e-12
development_run_6_2.other_columns: rule inputs and untolerated columns exact; PR-AUC max 9.91e-4; FPR at 0.1% max 6.33e-6
development_run_6_2.condition_9_2_4: met as run and reported, failed; no development estimate for no_extractor_features
development_run_6_2.on_2018: no_extractor_features still runs as in 6.2; its 2018 result is reported as an external exploratory ablation only, with no development-to-external claim
